q: The most useful content in a prior behavior intervention plan is:
choices: A. The credentials of the analyst who authored the plan
B. The number of goals and objectives it listed
C. The procedures used and what the data showed happened
D. The diagnosis and eligibility category recorded at intake

q: The contingency reversal phase of a brief functional analysis serves primarily to:
choices: A. Shorten the appointment by removing a control condition
B. Establish the client's preference among available reinforcers
C. Reduce the risk of injury during assessment sessions
D. Verify the identified contingency using an alternative response

q: An item ranked last in an MSWO is best described as:
choices: A. Suitable only for use with high-effort tasks
B. Outcompeted, but not established as a non-reinforcer
C. Likely to function as a punisher if delivered contingently
D. Confirmed to have no reinforcing function
